design: Exceptionally tall slender archivist with a high broad forehead, pointed lower mandibles and very short dreadlocks surrounding the back crown. Sleeveless split black robe with a long stiff rectangular silver-edged central panel, narrow asymmetrical shoulder wrap. Two thin rectangular record plaques stacked under the left forearm; right index claw points toward one plaque. Pale sandstone mottled skin.
